question: debrid/fakirdebrid $.extras.host_matrix.hosts_listed holds 64 from a 2026-10-23 probe, but two first-party status reads on 2026-11-25 each list 61 host rows. Should the field be set to 61, given that no measured-rung probe can carry the current row count?
why: Two first-party status-page reads on 2026-11-25 each list 61 host rows; the record holds 64 at rung measured from a probe read on 2026-10-23. Direct probes of the origin answer HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge), so no probe record exists at the measured rung to carry a 61-row count, and this lane cannot lower the record rung.
